quote:
Do not fall for scammers.
Here are a few settings changes that can help filter out the scammers. This may not stop all of them so please exercise your best judgment and report/block them. 
1.    Click on the gear icon at the bottom left of your screen to open up the settings, look for “Friend Requests” and turn off the first option. This will block most of the scammers/impersonators. 
2.    Privacy & Safety setting--click on User settings, then click on block direct messages from others and click Filter from non-friends option. 
3.    You can also click on Server settings and make sure Message request is turned on. This will help filter out DMs from non friends into a separate “message requests” folder.
Feel free to explore other settings and make any changes you see necessary. Let’s help each other keep our community safe.

author: Angel (az)
quote:
Hi all, sharing this just in case anyone else happens to run into the exact mind-boggling bug that I did on IBKR. I've been trying to request approval for Options for 2 months now and FINALLY got it working today. It's a super specific issue but just in case anyone else ever runs into this problem, because who knows how long it will take for the technical team to fix the bug lol. What happened to me was I was unable to change my trading experience on the "Options" tab because due to a bug, it would just never show up. So I could not update experience, and therefore could request approval to trade, but it would never even submit to IBKR. I was finally able to change my trading experience by requesting the other assets - I believe under "Futures" or "Complex or Leveraged", I changed my trading experience. So that let me bypass the first bug. 

After doing this, I was still unable to get approved for Options even though I got approval for Futures immediately. It just took me another 2 weeks of fiddling around to realize that the little pencil icon that you think of as "Edit" is NOT the same as the "Add/Edit" button beneath it. So my page would show "Options level 4" with a pencil and I had no approval to trade, and I would always try to request permissions by clicking the pencil to edit which level I wanted. I'd select level 2, then hit submit, and IBKR's website would show me a confirmation page saying my request has been submitted. But speaking to customer service, they would say no request is pending, and then they would tell me it's my experience level, hence starting the entire cycle of issues again. I randomly decided to edit the options level using the LOWER button today (the one under the red circle), and using the lower button to request level 2, I got approval immediately. Hopefully if anyone ever runs into the same thing, this will save them time!

author: Daniel
quote:
Sharing my TWS setup here, it might help other newbies with the learning curve?

I’ve been experimenting with TWS layouts today and found something that really helped! I discovered this morning Advanced Charts in TWS and tested a new setup/view. With the TradingView style charts built in, I realized I don’t really need to keep a separate TV window open anymore (I still do tho, but I can use it for QQQ or else).

Here’s what I did:

I linked my stock chart, watchlist, and option chain (highlighted in green).

After pulling the contracts I wanted to monitor into the Quote Monitor, I linked (in red) the option chart (in this case, the 22.5C) with the BookTrader window.

This way, I can see both the stock and the option side by side, no need for a second monitor or guessing the contract’s chart performance elsewhere. It’s probably not a perfect setup, but it really simplified things for me today!

One thing I still haven’t figured out: getting orders to show on the chart. The setting is enabled, but for some reason, nothing appears. If anyone’s solved that, I’d love to know!

author: Chip
quote: Hi, Ill send you the two monitor TOS setup I found helpful for Live and 1 monitor setup for Paper.  Highly suggest you use seperate Worksheet setups for Paper and Live since there are bugs otherwise.  I use 3 monitors for TOS while running Paper and Live at the same time.  I use 3 differnt monitors for Trading View and another Pc with 2 screens for other work like viewing Discord and youtube, etc.  I effort has been to try and Setup for the Stocks that they may pull the triger on.  So i fill in the 15 Watch Lists by using the copy function from the 3 option chains/ paste into the 15 Watchlists and then while the stock is still in the Mouse also paste to the 15 graphs.  One at a time obviously.  It usually starts off with 5-6 stocks they are watching, Jack on live and sometimes Tony too or on txt.  But as the market opens other stocks come onto their radar or change from Putts to Calls.   So i Setup as far as i can go before they say they are investing at that point.      I also use One Note free software for another 15 position indicator board to better keep tract of what stock are in what graphs and notes about them.  I also use a free window software called Fancy Zones within Power Tools buy Microsoft. It helps keep the windows organized.   The One Note feature that allows the ribbon up top of the Graph page is called Dock to desktop.  Ive been amazed that it has taken me 6 weeks to find solutions that would keep up with Tony and Jack during live Trading sessions.  It could be Im trying to Copy Trade at this point which probably requires more setup of more stocks than one doing their own thing while listening and getting tips from Live tony and Jack.   hope this helps.  Good luck

author: Connor James
quote: Hi Chip, I am also using TOS with 2 monitors. Do you mind sending me your 2 monitor set up if you are still using it? Tks!

author: Chip
quote: Hi James, Yes Im still using it.  Their are 3 pics in my previous post two of them are what you are asking for, the 3rd is labled "Paper Setup".  What you want is on the two other pics...one is the Selection Monitor (pick strikes) the other is the Trade Monitor (place trades).   The above is the overall setup with 15 Trade graphs on Trade monitor and on the Selection Monitor I have 3 Option Chains and 15 small watchlists.  I have noticed that with Tony and Jack together I needed 18 graphs on trade and i have gone to using 1 Master Watchlist with another to drag working or high interest strikes into.   I can update in a week or two if you wish.  I found it is imperitive be lightning fast and my way is to have all the 5-20 Stocks that they mention ready to buy.  Step 1 would be quickly picking the Strike Prices putting them into a Watchlist.  Step 2 is to have the Watchlist setup to be efficient and quick to put into the Trade Graphs.  Initially i thought that a watchlist per Trade Graph was way to go but too slow and confusing.  Now I go with a 1 W.list A-Z and use all availabe indicators to seperate and proritize that Master W.list.  I do use 6 color codes for the most popular Top Row of the T.Graph Grid to be quickest. The rest I drag and drop from W.List to any area of the T.Graph. I think im up to 2 months now in orgainzing TOS to keep up with them.  Once there I can start setting up Review methods to learn.  Ive attached where i am today, two pics one for the Selection Monitor, o ne for the Trade Graph Grid.  good luck trading
